article.headline: Columbus Crew routs Inter Miami 3-0 in dominant South Beach soccer display
article.summary: Columbus Crew defeated Inter Miami 3-0 on Saturday evening after exploiting defensive weaknesses and benefiting from a red card.
article.body: Taha Habroune stood near the box with time to consider his options, reflecting the ease with which Columbus cut through a shoddy Miami defense to net the team's second goal. The Crew dismantled the reigning MLS Cup champions throughout the match, ultimately securing a comfortable 3-0 victory away from home. While Miami was reduced to 10 men following a second yellow card issued to Gonzalo Lujan in the 36th minute, the visiting side had already claimed the lead while playing against a full squad. The win serves as a tactical blueprint for other teams, demonstrating how an ambitious passing game can expose the defensive frailties inherent in the current Miami lineup. By consistently finding space and executing intricate passing sequences, Columbus maintained control even when facing individual threats from Lionel Messi, who was repeatedly denied by excellent saves from goalkeeper Patrick Schulte. According to Goal.com, the result was far too simple for the Crew, who passed and moved their way to victory without breaking a sweat against a team struggling to cope with organized opponents. The game highlights significant gaps in the Miami defensive structure that persist despite the presence of star players. Both sides will look to adjust their strategies following this performance, as Miami attempts to address their defensive vulnerabilities while the Crew continues to demonstrate the effectiveness of their brave, possession-based approach in the Major League Soccer season.

article.headline: YEIDEP Grant Payments Begin January 5 Across 13 Nigerian Financial Institutions
article.summary: The Federal Government will begin disbursing Youth Economic Intervention and De-Radicalisation Programme funds on January 5, 2027.
article.body:
Beneficiaries are urged to visit their respective financial institutions immediately as the nationwide distribution of Automated Teller Machine cards begins ahead of the scheduled payment start date. The Youth Economic Intervention and De-Radicalisation Programme (YEIDEP) mandate requires that all accounts be opened and domiciled with one of the 13 participating banks to ensure seamless access to the upcoming funds.

This initiative serves as a crucial financial support mechanism for Nigerian citizens aged 18 to 50. By coordinating with 13 major banks, the programme aims to streamline the disbursement process, ensuring that registered participants can collect their cards and prepare their accounts before the disbursement kicks off in early January.

According to Comrade Kennedy Iyere, the Coordinator-General of YEIDEP, the participating banks include Keystone Bank, Fidelity Bank, United Bank for Africa, Union Bank, Guaranty Trust Bank, Wema Bank, Zenith Bank, Access Bank, Signature Bank, Ecobank, Lotus Bank, Alpha Morgan Bank, and TAJ Bank. These institutions have been instructed to conduct large-scale issuance of cards to all registered members whose accounts are currently domiciled within their systems.

Despite the upcoming January deadline for payments, the enrolment phase for the programme remains active. Prospective beneficiaries can continue to register and open their accounts until February 15, 2027, as the recruitment drive stays valid throughout the initial stages of the fund distribution.

article.headline: Towering Gilas routs Syria by 39 points in World Cup qualifying debut
article.summary: Gilas Pilipinas cruised to a 97-58 victory over Syria on Friday to improve to a 5-4 record in the FIBA Basketball World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers.
article.body: Kai Sotto needed only 17 minutes and 40 seconds to post a dominant 18-point, 10-rebound performance as the Philippines secured a lopsided victory at Karisma Arena in Seremban, Malaysia. The win marked the third consecutive victory for the squad, moving them above .500 in the Group E standings with a 5-4 record, while Syria remained at the bottom of the group with a 2-7 standing. The matchup featured a commanding display of physical dominance from the Filipino frontcourt, which controlled the boards to out-rebound their opponents significantly. Following a 43-32 halftime lead, Gilas broke the game open with a 29-13 third quarter behind a relentless shooting display from downtown, ultimately leading by as many as 40 points during the contest. This triumph is vital for the Philippines as the team navigates the fifth of six windows in the qualification process. Coach Tim Cone praised the team’s ability to execute within their established systems, specifically highlighting the seamless debut of naturalized player Bennie Boatwright. Boatwright finished his first outing in a national team jersey with a double-double of 16 points and 13 rebounds. The frontcourt depth was further bolstered by the defensive efforts of Mike Phillips and Quentin Millora-Brown, who combined for 13 rebounds and two blocks. Kevin Quiambao also contributed a game-high-tying 18 points, converting 6-of-8 from beyond the arc to help solidify the lopsided result.

article.headline: Target Stores Prepare For Early Morning Rush During 2026 Black Friday Event
article.summary: Target locations will be open for in-store shopping on Black Friday, November 27, 2026, after remaining closed on Thanksgiving Day.
article.body:
Target shoppers looking to browse store aisles in person should prepare for early morning hours this Black Friday, November 27, 2026. While many major big-box and department stores keep their physical doors locked throughout the entirety of Thanksgiving Day, November 26, the arrival of Black Friday marks the transition back to standard retail operations for most locations.

Knowing when your specific Target branch opens is essential for planning a shopping route, as regional schedules and local mall rules often dictate the exact start time for doors to open. While the company shifts away from the tradition of opening on the holiday itself, the Black Friday shopping window remains one of the busiest times of the year. Because local operations can vary significantly depending on the site or shopping center, shoppers should confirm hours for their nearest location before heading out to ensure they do not arrive before the store is ready.

According to NBC 5 Chicago, many stores across the region are planning to open their doors well before the sun comes up to accommodate the holiday crowds. Mashable notes that while physical locations remain closed on Thanksgiving, digital platforms, apps, and websites will continue to host Black Friday deals throughout the holiday. Retailers expect a high volume of traffic as customers move from online browsing on Thanksgiving to the traditional, in-store shopping experience the following morning.

Shoppers are encouraged to verify specific store hours through the Target website or app, as localized adjustments are common. With the shift in holiday retail trends, the in-store experience now centers entirely on the Friday morning opening.
